title: How to add windshield washer fluid
metaDesc: How to add windshield washer fluid: find the cap with the windshield symbol, use winter fluid when it freezes, and never put coolant in the washer tank.
first: Find the cap with the windshield-spray symbol. It's often blue.
Fill it with washer fluid. In cold weather use a winter fluid that won't freeze.
Plain water is OK only if you have nothing else and it isn't freezing.
Never pour coolant (antifreeze) into the washer tank. It smears the windshield and can block your view.
dont: Don't pour washer fluid into the coolant, brake fluid or oil.
Keep sparks and flames away from washer fluid.
Washer fluid is poisonous: keep it away from kids and pets.

steps.t: Find the washer tank. The cap has a windshield-spray symbol. Your owner's manual shows where it is.
Pour in washer fluid until it's near the top. Close the cap.
Try the washer switch to make sure it sprays.

call: If the washers still don't spray with a full tank, have them checked. Clear glass matters for safe driving.

sources.t: Kia owner's manual: Checking the washer fluid level
